descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your court. Your yacht. Your ocean.

CENTRE COURT AT SEA
A full-size tennis court runs the length of the aft deck, glass-fenced, with the open sea on both sides and a tropical island on the horizon. The ball machine feeds groundstrokes, volleys, lobs and serves with real bounce and topspin, and your racket is in your hand the moment you step behind the baseline. Swing across the ball and aim with the strings.

DRILLS AND LEVELS
Rally, Set, Targets and Climb drills across four levels from Social to Tour. The scoreboard tracks returns, shot speed, streak and your best. Hit one over 80 mph and the WINNER banner lights up, confetti flies and the guests on the upper deck cheer.

WALK THE WHOLE YACHT
Step through the glass gate and explore: the pool deck, the salon and dining room, the master suite, the sky lounge, the bridge where the captain is at the helm, and the sun deck with its lounge and hot tub. The sliding glass doors open for you as you walk up.

JET SKI AND BUOY RACE
Walk down to the swim platform, press A and you are riding the jet ski. Right trigger for throttle, left stick to steer, and a real dash in the instrument screen shows your speed and lap. Follow the glowing beacon round eight race buoys and chase your best lap.

LIFE ON THE WATER
Dolphins leap alongside, gulls wheel overhead, the sea sparkles in the afternoon sun and a big tropical island sits on the horizon.
